name: dev.workers.bsptimber.linkproof/linkproof
title: LinkProof
description: Pay-per-call AI agent tools: fact-check, web page to Markdown, domain report, Base wallet lookup.

tools.name: verify_answer
tools.description: Hallucination check / source checker for an AI answer in one call. Send the answer text (max 50,000 chars); LinkProof extracts every URL, DOI, arXiv id and PubMed id (or pass urls/citations), checks each link (live, dead/404, soft-404, parked, unreachable), verifies each citation in Crossref, arXiv or PubMed against claimed title/authors/year, and finds Wayback copies of dead links. Up to 10 links + 10 citations. Returns all_ok or problems_found plus per-item verdicts.

text.description: The AI answer or document to fact-check; URLs, DOIs, arXiv ids and PubMed ids are extracted automatically

citations.description: Optional extra references (DOI, arXiv id, PMID, free text, or {title, authors, year})

archive_dead_links.description: Look up Wayback Machine copies for dead links (default true)

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Web page reader / scraper for AI agents: fetch one public URL and get clean Markdown of the main content (boilerplate, menus and scripts removed), or text from a PDF link. Returns title, description, language, author, publish date, word count, optional links, and an AI-usage hint (robots.txt AI crawler rules, Content-Signal, meta robots noai, X-Robots-Tag). Up to 100,000 chars. Failed fetches and JS-only pages are not charged. Price: 0.002 USDC per call (x402, Base).

url.description: Public http(s) page or PDF URL

include_links.description: Also return links found in the content

ai_policy.description: Check robots.txt / meta / X-Robots-Tag AI-usage signals (default true)

tools.name: domain_report
tools.description: Domain health / trust check in one call: DNS (A, AAAA, NS, CAA, DNSSEC), WHOIS via RDAP (registration date, domain age, expiry, registrar, status), SSL/TLS certificate from Certificate Transparency logs (issuer, days left), HTTPS reachability and security headers grade, SPF / DMARC / MX / DKIM, robots.txt AI rules, security.txt and llms.txt. Returns a 0-100 health score, risk level and plain-language findings (new domain, expiring cert, no DMARC...).

domain.description: Domain, URL or email address (only the domain is used)

tools.name: base_lookup
tools.description: Base (chain 8453) on-chain lookup for AI agents: wallet ETH balance and ERC-20 token balances (USDC, WETH, cbBTC, USDbC, EURC, DAI, cbETH, AERO plus up to 10 custom tokens), nonce and contract check; resolve a Basename (name.base.eth) to an address and the wallet's primary Basename; ERC-20 token info (name, symbol, decimals, total supply); latest block, base fee, gas price and transfer cost estimate. Read-only public RPC data. Price: 0.001 USDC per call (x402, Base).

tokens.description: Extra ERC-20 token addresses for the wallet balances

tools.name: verify_links
tools.description: Broken link checker and dead link checker for AI agents: verify up to 10 URLs before citing or sending them. Per URL returns a verdict (live, dead/404, soft_404, parked domain, blocked_or_rate_limited, unreachable/DNS error), HTTP status, final URL after redirects, page title, meta description, and optionally whether an expected phrase appears on the page. Catches hallucinated, rotted and redirected-to-homepage links. Price: 0.005 USDC per call (x402, Base).

tools.name: verify_citations
tools.description: Citation checker / reference verifier: check that up to 10 references an AI cites really exist. Accepts DOI, arXiv id, PubMed id (PMID), free-text reference, or {title, authors, year}. Looks them up in Crossref (DataCite fallback), arXiv and NCBI PubMed and returns, per citation, exists, matched metadata (title, authors, year, venue, URL), field mismatches, confidence and a verdict: verified, mismatch, not_found or error. Catches hallucinated or misattributed papers.

tools.name: find_archive
tools.description: Wayback Machine / Internet Archive lookup for dead links and link rot: for up to 10 URLs, find the closest archived snapshot, optionally nearest to a given date. Returns snapshot URL, capture timestamp, captured HTTP status and distance in days from the requested date. Use it to replace or back up broken citations. Price: 0.005 USDC per call (x402, Base).

tools.name: check_headers
tools.description: HTTP security headers audit / scanner for up to 5 URLs or domains: HSTS, Content-Security-Policy (CSP), X-Frame-Options / frame-ancestors (clickjacking), X-Content-Type-Options (nosniff), Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, COOP/CORP, cookie flags (Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite; names only), HTTPS redirect and server version disclosure. Returns an A-F grade, score and fixes. Headers only; no TLS certificate check. Price: 0.002 USDC per call (x402, Base).

tools.name: site_policies
tools.description: robots.txt, llms.txt and security.txt checker for up to 5 sites: fetches robots.txt, llms.txt, llms-full.txt, ai.txt and /.well-known/security.txt in parallel. Parses robots.txt rules for AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, CCBot, PerplexityBot and others) and the * group, says whether a given path is allowed to crawl, lists sitemap URLs, and reports security.txt contact and expiry. Use it before crawling or scraping a site. Price: 0.002 USDC per call (x402, Base).

path.description: Default path to test against robots.txt

tools.name: email_auth
tools.description: SPF, DKIM and DMARC checker (email authentication audit) for up to 5 domains: reads SPF, DMARC, MX and common DKIM selectors via DNS-over-HTTPS (Cloudflare, Google fallback). Reports presence, policy strength, common misconfigurations (multiple SPF records, more than 10 SPF DNS lookups, +all or missing all, missing or multiple DMARC, DMARC p=none), a simple A-F grade and recommendations. DNS check only: mailboxes are never probed and it is not a deliverability guarantee.

domains.description: Domains, or email addresses (only the domain is used)

tools.name: injection_scan
tools.description: Prompt injection detection / scanner for untrusted text before an LLM agent reads it (web pages, emails, documents, tool output). Rule-based scan of up to 50 KB for instruction-override phrases, system-prompt reveal requests, DAN-style jailbreaks, hidden or bidi unicode, base64-encoded instructions and tool/markdown-image exfiltration. Returns risk (none to critical), matches with offsets and a sanitized copy. Heuristic; text not stored. Price: 0.003 USDC per call (x402, Base).

tools.name: wiki_summary
tools.description: Wikipedia summary / article lookup: for up to 3 titles or search queries (optional language code), return the short extract, article URL, thumbnail, Wikidata id and ready-to-use CC BY-SA 4.0 attribution from the Wikimedia REST API. Cached. Price: 0.005 USDC per call (x402, Base).

tools.name: license_detect
tools.description: Open source license detector: identify the SPDX license id (MIT, Apache-2.0, GPL-2.0/3.0, LGPL, AGPL, BSD-2/3-Clause, MPL-2.0, ISC, Unlicense, CC0-1.0, CC-BY/SA, EPL-2.0 and others) from license text or a public LICENSE file URL. Returns confidence and key permissions, conditions and limitations. Not legal advice. Price: 0.003 USDC per call (x402, Base).

url.description: Public URL of a LICENSE file

tools.name: ics_parse
tools.description: ICS / iCalendar parser: parse ICS text or a public .ics calendar URL. Returns VEVENTs with summary, start/end normalized to UTC/ISO (or marked floating), timezone, location, and RRULE recurring events expanded to at most 50 occurrences in a bounded window. Data is not stored. Price: 0.003 USDC per call (x402, Base).
